Package org.cibseven.connect.ai.agent.agentic

Class AgenticToolCatalogParser.Parsing

java.lang.Object
org.cibseven.connect.ai.agent.agentic.AgenticToolCatalogParser.Parsing
Enclosing class:
AgenticToolCatalogParser
public static final class AgenticToolCatalogParser.Parsing extends Object
One parse of a process, as the agent's checks see it (CIB7-2136, CIB7-2367): which process, and whether it is deployed now or only parsed again, from a deployment made earlier, after a restart, a cache eviction or on another node.

The checks refuse a model when it is deployed. A model parsed again that they would refuse was deployed when nothing checked it: while the AI agent was off, or before the check existed. Refused now, it would stop every instance of it, and every command that needs the definition, even the ones that would end them. So then a check only logs what it would refuse, and the model loads without the part it refuses: a scope no agent can run stays the plain ad hoc scope it was deployed as, and a broken tool, parameter or setting is left out. The engine treats its own checks that depend on the configuration the same way, as the history time to live.

The rule for a check added after a release: on a parse again it leaves out the part it refuses, a tool, a parameter or a setting, never the agent. "Loads as it was deployed, without the agent" holds only for a model deployed while the agent was off. One deployed with the agent on, before the check existed, ran with its agent, and its instances wait for turns that only the agent gives; without it they would wait for ever.
